notes.title: Bugfix + UI Tweaks
notes.content:
[list]
[*] Fixed bugged basket on Mountains hole 10.
[*] Added ability to choose starting hole.
[/list]

notes.title: UI Overhaul
notes.content:
[list]
[*] Updated UI all over the project.
[*] Added tutorial.
[*] Added replay button so you can watch your last throw again!
[/list]

notes.title: Sound and UI Improvements
notes.content:
[list]
[*] Added many more sounds to the game. Make those chains ring!
[*] Added range-finder feature available during rounds.
[*] Improved UI visibility and flow.
[/list]

This is the beginning of a big UI push, keep your eye out for more updates to come!

notes.title: Mountains
notes.content:
[list]
[*] Added Mountains course to the game. 
[*] Improved stat-tracking and viewing UI.
[*] Added zoom-out view, accessed by clicking in the stick.
[/list]

notes.title: Back 9 and Improved Release
notes.content:
[list]
[*] Added 9 more holes for all three courses!
[*] Added ability to start at any hole.
[*] Improved how wrist snap affects the throw. 
[/list]

notes.title: Playtest Feedback
notes.content:
[list]
[*] Fixed left hand pointer in menu
[*] Made bag open on hand that hit the bag button, preventing bag softlock when stuck in colliders
[*] Added practice basket to menu scene
[*] Lobby fish are now grabbable! 

Thank you to all the playtesters, keep on DISCIN! 

[/list]
